name: Crawler
description: EXECUTION: INTAKE — reads a folder the browser has been given and turns it into a corpus: a pre-scan pie chart of what is in there, a deep crawl with AST parsing in WebAssembly, and an EVERYTHING.LOG plus a MAP.txt out the far end. THIS FOLDER IS A FACADE: its two entries are tracked symlinks, Thick -> APK:DOCKERS/APK:audio:WebPortal/SRC/APK:Softapps/Softapp:Crawler (the Tkinter desktop half) and Thin -> APK:DOCKERS/APK:audio:WebPortal/SRC/APK:FrontEnd/Thin (this one, a Next.js static export). The app named here is a build artefact — Thin/out/ is generated and untracked, so the crawler lane builds before it checks. THIS FILE OWNS THE STAGE: pipeline.json's _comment rules that an application's own display.json wins over the apps map, so 01 · Event is the application's placement. The two symlink targets are separate keys in that map and were filed at 07c · Monitor — neither this stage nor a decision anybody took, but a bare-leaf-name filing PLAN-378.01 carried across while repairing the path. Both rows now read 01, and .apk.scripts/check_display_registry.py section 9 fails if a facade and its symlink target ever file different stages again. PLAN-502.01 holds it.
